title: Oakhaven level 5 · SRD 5.2.1
party: Calder Voss (Fighter), Ness Quinn (Rogue), Halden Moss (Cleric), Mira Quill (Wizard)

carryForward.name: Wand of Secrets
carryForward.text: Uncommon. No attunement. 3 charges, regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn, expend 1 charge. 2014: an action, secret door or trap within 30 feet. 2024: a Magic action, within 60 feet.

carryForward.name: Cloak of Protection
carryForward.text: Uncommon, requires attunement. +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while worn. Oakhaven calls it the Saltglass Cloak. The bonus matches SRD 5.2 and the SRD 5.1 Cloak of Protection.

carryForward.name: Pearl of Power
carryForward.text: Uncommon, requires attunement by a spellcaster. SRD 5.2: Magic action, regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower, once until the next dawn. SRD 5.1 wording differs: an action can regain one expended slot, and a slot of 4th level or higher becomes a 3rd-level slot. At these levels nobody has a 4th-level slot, so the result matches.

carryForward.name: +1 Longsword
carryForward.text: Weapon, +1. Uncommon. SRD 5.2 does not require attunement. +1 to attack rolls and damage rolls with this weapon. SRD 5.1 +1 weapons likewise do not require attunement.

dropInNote: These four are the series party. They carry every permanent SRD magic item earned on the best path of each earlier Oakhaven module. Consumables are not assumed to remain. A table that drops in without those modules can set the extra items aside. SRD 5.2 Starting at Higher Levels gives a smaller default kit (levels 2–4: one common item; levels 5–10: one common and one uncommon). The series kit is earned treasure, not that starting package.
unsettledRules: Settled: SRD 5.1 has no encounter-budget table. These sheets do not print 2014 Easy, Medium, Hard, or Deadly labels. Encounter bands use the SRD 5.2.1 XP budget.

Settled: Boots of Elvenkind need no attunement in SRD 5.1 or SRD 5.2. 2014 grants advantage only on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently. 2024 grants Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and your steps make no sound.

Settled: 2014 Life Domain always prepares Spiritual Weapon from cleric level 3 and Beacon of Hope from cleric level 5. Both spells are printed on those 2014 sheets. 2024 Life Domain does not prepare either spell.
Settled: Wand of Secrets has 3 charges and regains 1d3 at dawn in both editions. 2014: an action, secret door or trap within 30 feet. 2024: a Magic action, within 60 feet.
Settled: Hunter Shark and Giant Constrictor Snake are printed with separate 2014 and 2024 attack lines in the adventures.
Settled edition difference: 2024 Cure Wounds is 2d8 + modifier and Healing Word is 2d4 + modifier. 2014 is 1d8 + modifier and 1d4 + modifier.
Settled edition difference: 2024 Lesser Restoration is a Bonus Action and does not mention disease. 2014 is an action and can end one disease.

Settled: 2024 subclasses begin at level 3. 2014 Life Domain is level 1. 2014 Evocation school is level 2. 2014 Champion and Thief are level 3. 2024 Channel Divinity is 2 uses at cleric levels 2–5 and 3 uses at level 6.

characters.name: Calder Voss
characters.role: Front line. Holds the door and the wounded.
characters.acNotes: Chain mail 16 + shield 2 + Defense 1 = 19. Attacks below include the +1 longsword.

attackList.name: +1 Longsword
attackList.notes: Versatile 1d10+5. Sap mastery. Extra Attack: two attacks with the Attack action.

featureList.name: Fighting Style: Defense
featureList.text: While wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, +1 AC. Included in AC 19.

featureList.name: Second Wind
featureList.text: Bonus Action: regain 1d10 + 5 HP. 2 uses. Regain 1 use on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest.

featureList.name: Resourceful
featureList.text: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest. Expend it to reroll any die immediately after rolling it, and use the new roll. You can never have more than one.

featureList.name: Weapon Mastery
featureList.text: Longsword (Sap), Spear (Sap), Handaxe (Vex). Sap: on a hit, the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn. The class table grants 4 masteries from level 4. Choose the fourth weapon from the SRD list at the table; this sheet does not invent a fourth property.

featureList.name: Savage Attacker
featureList.text: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll.

featureList.name: Alert
featureList.text: Add proficiency bonus to Initiative. After rolling Initiative, you may swap with one willing ally who is not Incapacitated.

featureList.name: Action Surge
featureList.text: On your turn, take one additional action, except the Magic action. Once until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

featureList.name: Tactical Mind
featureList.text: When you fail an ability check, expend Second Wind to add 1d10 instead of healing. If the check still fails, the use is not spent.

featureList.name: Improved Critical
featureList.text: Weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks crit on 19–20.

featureList.name: Remarkable Athlete
featureList.text: Advantage on Initiative and Strength (Athletics). After a Critical Hit, move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. 2014 Remarkable Athlete is level 7 and is not on this sheet.

featureList.name: Extra Attack
featureList.text: Attack twice, instead of once, when you take the Attack action on your turn.

featureList.name: Tactical Shift
featureList.text: When you use Second Wind as a Bonus Action, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

personality.trait: Counts doors, spears, and people before he counts treasure.
personality.ideal: The town stands if somebody holds the line.
personality.bond: Oakhaven's east gate taught him the job.
personality.flaw: He will not leave a fallen person to make a cleaner retreat.

characters.appearance: Broad human in chain mail, shield scarred, voice flat and brief.
characters.features: Fighting Style: Defense; Second Wind; Resourceful; Weapon Mastery; Savage Attacker; Alert; Action Surge; Tactical Mind; Improved Critical; Remarkable Athlete; Extra Attack; Tactical Shift
characters.gear: Chain mail, Shield, +1 longsword, 4 javelins, +1 Longsword

magicItems.name: +1 Longsword
magicItems.text: Weapon, +1. Uncommon. SRD 5.2 does not require attunement. +1 to attack rolls and damage rolls with this weapon. SRD 5.1 +1 weapons likewise do not require attunement.

characters.name: Ness Quinn
characters.role: Locks, scouting, and the wand that finds traps.

attackList.name: Shortsword
attackList.notes: Finesse. Sneak Attack +3d6 once per turn when it qualifies. Vex.

attackList.name: Dagger
attackList.notes: Finesse, light, thrown 20/60. Nick: one Light extra attack as part of the Attack action, no ability modifier on its damage unless the modifier is negative.

bonusActions: Cunning Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide

featureList.name: Expertise
featureList.text: Double proficiency on Stealth and Sleight of Hand.

featureList.name: Sneak Attack
featureList.text: Once per turn, +3d6 weapon damage with a Finesse or ranged weapon if you have Advantage, or if an ally is within 5 feet of the target and you do not have Disadvantage. 2024 ally must not be Incapacitated. 2014 ally must not be incapacitated.

featureList.name: Resourceful
featureList.text: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest. Expend it to reroll any die immediately after rolling it, and use the new roll. You can never have more than one.

featureList.name: Weapon Mastery
featureList.text: Shortsword (Vex) and Dagger (Nick). Vex: when you hit and deal damage, Advantage on your next attack against that creature before the end of your next turn. Nick: the Light extra attack is part of the Attack action, once per turn.

featureList.name: Alert
featureList.text: Add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative. Immediately after rolling Initiative, you may swap with one willing ally in the same combat unless you or that ally is Incapacitated.

featureList.name: Savage Attacker
featureList.text: Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll.

featureList.name: Cunning Action
featureList.text: Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

featureList.name: Fast Hands
featureList.text: Bonus Action: Sleight of Hand to pick a lock, disarm a trap, or pick a pocket; or take the Utilize action; or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires that action.

featureList.name: Second-Story Work
featureList.text: Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Jump distance uses Dexterity instead of Strength.

featureList.name: Steady Aim
featureList.text: Bonus Action: Advantage on your next attack this turn if you have not moved. Speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn. Not a 2014 SRD feature.

featureList.name: Uncanny Dodge
featureList.text: Reaction when an attacker you can see hits you: halve that attack's damage (round down).

featureList.name: Cunning Strike
featureList.text: When you deal Sneak Attack, forgo 1d6 to add one effect. DC 8 + Dex mod + prof. Trip: Large or smaller target, Dex save or Prone. Withdraw: move half your Speed without Opportunity Attacks. Poison needs a Poisoner's Kit and is not carried.

personality.trait: Names the exit before she names the treasure.
personality.ideal: A locked door is a question, not an insult.
personality.bond: The eastern lane still knows her knock.
personality.flaw: She will open the box before anyone agrees.

characters.appearance: Lean human in studded leather, ink on two fingers, boots quieter than the floor.
characters.features: Expertise; Sneak Attack; Resourceful; Weapon Mastery; Alert; Savage Attacker; Cunning Action; Fast Hands; Second-Story Work; Steady Aim; Uncanny Dodge; Cunning Strike
characters.gear: Studded leather, Shortsword, 2 daggers, Thieves' tools, Wand of Secrets

characters.name: Halden Moss
characters.role: Keeps people alive and answers the shrine.
characters.acNotes: Chain mail 16 + shield 2 = 18 + Cloak of Protection 1 = 19. Cloak also adds +1 to every saving throw.

attackList.name: Mace
attackList.notes: One melee attack. Spellcasting is the better action most rounds.

attackList.name: Sacred Flame
attackList.notes: Dexterity save DC 15, not an attack roll.

spellcasting.prepareCount: SRD 5.2 class table says 9 prepared spells; domain spells are extra. This sheet prints only spells whose text was checked. Fill any empty slots from the SRD cleric list.

spellList.name: Sacred Flame
spellList.effect: Dex save DC 15 or 2d8 radiant. Cover does not help. Cantrip die becomes 2d8 at level 5 in both editions.

spellList.name: Guidance
spellList.effect: Concentration, 1 minute. One willing creature adds 1d4 to one ability check.

spellList.name: Light
spellList.effect: One object sheds bright light 20 ft. and dim light 20 ft. for 1 hour.

spellList.name: Cure Wounds
spellList.effect: One creature regains 2d8 + 4 HP. 2024 is 2d8 + mod; 2014 is 1d8 + mod. Disciple of Life adds 2 + slot level when that feature is on this sheet.

spellList.name: Healing Word
spellList.effect: One creature you can see regains 2d4 + 4 HP. 2024 is 2d4 + mod; 2014 is 1d4 + mod.

spellList.name: Bless
spellList.effect: Concentration, 1 minute. Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

spellList.name: Shield of Faith
spellList.effect: Concentration, 10 minutes. One creature gains +2 AC.

spellList.name: Spare the Dying
spellList.effect: A living creature at 0 HP becomes stable.

spellList.name: Lesser Restoration
spellList.effect: End Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. 2024 casting time is a Bonus Action. 2014 is an action and can also end one disease.

spellList.name: Aid
spellList.effect: 8 hours. Up to three creatures: +5 max HP and +5 current HP. +5 more per slot level above 2.

spellList.name: Revivify
spellList.effect: A creature that died within the last minute returns with 1 HP. Consumes a diamond worth 300+ GP. Cannot restore missing body parts or death from old age.

spellList.name: Mass Healing Word
spellList.effect: Up to six creatures regain 2d4 + 4 HP.

featureList.name: Resourceful
featureList.text: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest. Expend it to reroll any die immediately after rolling it, and use the new roll. You can never have more than one.

featureList.name: Alert
featureList.text: Add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative. Immediately after rolling Initiative, you may swap with one willing ally in the same combat unless you or that ally is Incapacitated.

featureList.name: Divine Order: Protector
featureList.text: Martial weapon proficiency and Heavy armor training. Life Domain is not chosen until level 3 in 2024.

featureList.name: Magic Initiate (Cleric)
featureList.text: Guidance and Spare the Dying if not already known, and Bless always prepared. Cast Bless once without a slot per Long Rest; you may also spend a slot.

featureList.name: Channel Divinity (2 uses)
featureList.text: The SRD 5.2.1 cleric table gives 2 uses at level 5 (2 at levels 2–5, 3 at level 6). Regain 1 use on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest. Divine Spark: Magic action, 30 ft., 1d8 + Wis mod healing OR Con save for that much Necrotic or Radiant (half on success). Turn Undead: Wisdom save or Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute, moving away; damage ends it.

featureList.name: Disciple of Life
featureList.text: When you cast a spell with a slot that restores HP, the creature regains extra HP equal to 2 + the slot's level on that turn.

featureList.name: Preserve Life
featureList.text: Magic action, expend Channel Divinity: restore 25 HP divided among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet, including you. No creature above half its maximum.

featureList.name: Sear Undead
featureList.text: When you use Turn Undead, each Undead that fails the save also takes Radiant damage equal to a number of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1d8).

personality.trait: Asks who is hurt before he asks what is evil.
personality.ideal: A prayer that does not help a body is unfinished.
personality.bond: The chapel at Oakhaven still has his spare robe.
personality.flaw: He will spend the last slot on a stranger.

characters.appearance: Weathered human in chain mail under a plain cloak, holy symbol worn smooth.
characters.features: Resourceful; Alert; Divine Order: Protector; Magic Initiate (Cleric); Channel Divinity (2 uses); Disciple of Life; Preserve Life; Sear Undead
characters.gear: Chain mail, Shield, Mace, Holy symbol, Cloak of Protection

magicItems.name: Cloak of Protection
magicItems.text: Uncommon, requires attunement. +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while worn. Oakhaven calls it the Saltglass Cloak. The bonus matches SRD 5.2 and the SRD 5.1 Cloak of Protection.

characters.name: Mira Quill
characters.role: Control, fire, and the spell the party is missing.
characters.acNotes: Unarmored 10 + Dex 1 until Mage Armor: base AC 13 + Dex = 14.

attackList.name: Dagger
attackList.notes: Finesse, thrown 20/60. Use only if a spell is wrong.

spellList.name: Fire Bolt
spellList.effect: Ranged spell attack +7, 2d10 fire. A flammable unattended object starts burning. Potent Cantrip: half damage on a miss.

spellList.name: Prestidigitation
spellList.effect: A minor sensory effect: clean, soil, warm, chill, flavor, or a mark, lasting up to 1 hour.

spellList.name: Ray of Frost
spellList.effect: Ranged spell attack +7, 2d8 cold, and the target's speed drops by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

spellList.name: Mage Armor
spellList.effect: 8 hours. A willing unarmored creature's base AC becomes 13 + Dex modifier. On Mira that is 14.

spellList.name: Shield
spellList.effect: When you are hit by an attack or targeted by Magic Missile: +5 AC until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack, and Magic Missile deals no damage.

spellList.name: Magic Missile
spellList.effect: Three darts, each 1d4+1 force, hitting automatically. You may split them. +1 dart per slot level above 1.

spellList.name: Thunderwave
spellList.effect: Con save DC 15: 2d8 thunder and pushed 10 feet, or half damage and not pushed on a success.

spellList.name: Misty Step
spellList.effect: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spellList.name: Scorching Ray
spellList.effect: Three rays, each a ranged spell attack +7 for 2d6 fire. One extra ray per slot level above 2.

spellList.name: Fireball
spellList.effect: 20-foot radius. Dex save DC 15: 8d6 fire, half on a success. Unattended flammable objects ignite.

featureList.name: Arcane Recovery
featureList.text: Once per Long Rest, at the end of a Short Rest, recover expended slots whose total levels do not exceed 3 and none of which is 6th level or higher.

featureList.name: Ritual Adept
featureList.text: You can cast a ritual from your spellbook without preparing it. 2024 names this Ritual Adept; 2014 is part of Spellcasting. Read from the book.

featureList.name: Resourceful
featureList.text: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest. Expend it to reroll any die immediately after rolling it, and use the new roll. You can never have more than one.

featureList.name: Alert
featureList.text: Add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative. Immediately after rolling Initiative, you may swap with one willing ally in the same combat unless you or that ally is Incapacitated.

featureList.name: Scholar
featureList.text: Expertise in Arcana.

featureList.name: Magic Initiate (Wizard)
featureList.text: Light and Mage Hand, and Shield always prepared. Cast Shield once without a slot per Long Rest.

featureList.name: Potent Cantrip
featureList.text: If you miss with a damaging cantrip or the target saves, the target takes half the cantrip's damage and no extra effect. 2014 Potent Cantrip is level 6.

featureList.name: Evocation Savant
featureList.text: Two Evocation spells of level 2 or lower were added to the book for free (Thunderwave, Scorching Ray). When you gain a new slot level, add one Evocation spell of that level for free.

featureList.name: Memorize / 3rd-level slots
featureList.text: Memorize Spell: whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can replace one prepared spell with another spell from your book of a level you can cast.

personality.trait: Reads the label before she touches the bottle.
personality.ideal: A spell you cannot explain is a spell you should not cast yet.
personality.bond: Kaelen's drying room still has her old stool.
personality.flaw: She will spend the slot to learn what the thing is.

characters.appearance: Sharp-eyed human with a soot-marked spellbook and a staff wrapped in linen.
characters.features: Arcane Recovery; Ritual Adept; Resourceful; Alert; Scholar; Magic Initiate (Wizard); Potent Cantrip; Evocation Savant; Memorize / 3rd-level slots
characters.gear: Quarterstaff (arcane focus), Dagger, Spellbook, Component pouch, Pearl of Power
